documents.name: Bealach na Bà
documents.summary: An 18.1 km single-track crossing from the A896 at Tornapress over Bealach na Bà to the Applecross coast-road junction.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The route compresses a sea-level-to-high-pass crossing, unusually tight historic road engineering and a sudden west-coast reveal into a short but complete journey.
